label: D1 after a1->S1 omission; weaker if trial before also unrewarded
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only after the previous trial was a1 -> S1 unrewarded (residual +1.15; every other previous-trial pattern including a2 S1 u is about 0; GO and D2 are always 0). Magnitude on those steps: about 1.8 when the trial before was rewarded, falling by about 1.1 when the trial before was also unrewarded (two omissions in a row give about 0.4-1.0). It is higher when the ideal-observer belief still favours S1 (belief_lo weight +0.21) and decreases later in the episode (ep_dec weight -0.07). A small extra term covers window-first D1s after an omission where the previous trial is not in the window. Upcoming choice, reached state, future reward and hidden good state add nothing. Observed-only, 5 terms: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.70, test 0.69, above the profile all ceiling 0.61 (all observed 0.59); last_is(a1 S1 u) alone gives 0.52 dev. Model value/policy terms are not needed, so observed-only loses nothing measurable. Remaining error is mostly window-first D1s whose previous trial is unseen.

issues: Main remaining error: D1 steps at the start of a window (prev_action == -1) after an omission. Some reach about 2.5 against a prediction of about 0.26 (worst-fit dev windows). Only the reward input is observed there; the previous choice and state fall outside the window. Adding belief_lo or sign(belief_lo) at window start only reaches test 0.70, and the future upcoming choice only 0.705. So this is a limit of the data, not a missing cue, and the explanation already names it.

Ablations support every term on test. last_is(a1 S1 u) alone gives 0.509. Adding the omission on the trial before raises it to 0.647 (weight -1.28, so the claim holds). belief_lo adds about +0.02 (weight +0.19, positive as claimed) and ep_dec about +0.01 (weight -0.06 to -0.07, shrinking later in the episode as claimed). The full set scores test 0.694, matching the reported value.
Minor: the residual after a2 S1 u is about 0, while the other non-target patterns are about -0.09. A separate term for it adds nothing (weight 0.02), so the claim that it gives about 0 is fine.

Minor refinement: the dip after two omissions is shallower when the trial before was also a1->S1 (term weight +0.49), and a third earlier omission adds a further dip (-0.38). Together these add only +0.003 test R^2, so the label is not wrong for leaving them out.

The label leaves out the small belief and episode-time modulation, but the explanation states both correctly. No future variables are used, and the claim that going observed-only costs nothing is consistent with the profile: policy and value cues reach only 0.06 and 0.01 there.
